(Intro 前奏)
(深沉的808 Bass低频渐入，古筝单音在延迟回声中浮现)

(Verse 1 主歌一)
夜色漫过屋檐 灯火次第亮起
风从远方带来 旧时光的气息

(Pre-Chorus 导歌)
(琵琶轮指渐密，合成器铺底缓缓抬升)

(Chorus 副歌)
星夜旅人啊 别怕路途漫长
心口那盏灯 会照亮回家的方向

(Outro 尾声)
(鼓点逐渐抽离，只剩808低鸣与古筝余音缓缓淡出)
星夜旅人… 终会回到故乡…

[Global Metadata]
Genre: Chinoiserie Downtempo, Chinese electronica ballad
Tempo: 92 BPM, 4/4 time signature
Key: D minor with pentatonic-leaning melody
Mood: dreamy, nostalgic, serene; night-drift atmosphere
Dynamics: restrained and hypnotic, subtle builds, smooth long transitions

[Vocal Details]
Lead vocal: soft ethereal female voice, Mandarin Chinese
Delivery: intimate breathy verses, gently soaring chorus, light stacked harmonies in chorus

[Arrangement]
Intro: deep 808 bass pulse, guzheng plucks drenched in delay
Verse: sparse 808 groove, soft kick on quarter notes, guzheng arpeggios
Pre-Chorus: pipa tremolo builds, warm pads widen, subtle riser
Chorus: full downtempo beat, 808 sub-bass, guzheng counter-melody
Outro: drums fade out, low hum with guzheng residue slowly fade to silence
